title: The State of Independent Insurance Agency Websites 2026
note: Aggregates computed from automated scans. No individual site is identified.
attribution: Free to use and cite under CC BY 4.0. Credit Clikiti with a link.
citation: Clikiti. (2026, October 15). The state of independent insurance agency websites 2026 (Q4 2026) [Report]. https://clikiti.com/research/insurance/2026-q4
audience: Web agencies and freelancers selling to independent insurance agencies
findings: Only 22% of the 170 independent insurance agency websites we scanned show a licence number, an NPN or the states the agency is licensed in.
A typical site answers five of the nine questions clients ask before choosing (mean 4.7).
The median overall score is 77 out of 100 (mean 77).
The least-answered questions are "Are you licensed where I live?" (22%), "Do other clients vouch for you?" (36%) and "What do I do when I need to claim?" (39%).
The best-answered are "What can you insure?" (93%) and "Can I start a quote online?" (78%).
By kind of business, the highest median score is 78 (personal lines), against 78 for commercial and business, 77 for specialty: farm, marine and flood and 75 for life, health and Medicare.
94% fail "Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone" (Core Web Vitals · LCP).

agencyProblems.label: Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone
agencyProblems.fix: Resize and compress the hero image, defer chat and quote scripts, aim for under 2.5 s on a phone.
agencyProblems.pitch: Your home page takes several seconds to appear on a phone.

agencyProblems.label: Text contrast passes 4.5:1
agencyProblems.fix: Raise text contrast to at least 4.5:1 in the theme, including text over photos.
agencyProblems.pitch: Parts of the site are hard to read, and it is a WCAG failure.

agencyProblems.label: Licence number, NPN or licensed states shown
agencyProblems.question: Are you licensed where I live?
agencyProblems.fix: Put the agency licence number or NPN and the states it is licensed in on the footer and the about page.
agencyProblems.pitch: A client cannot see from your site whether you are licensed in their state.

agencyProblems.label: InsuranceAgency structured data
agencyProblems.fix: Add InsuranceAgency structured data with the address, phone, hours and areas served.
agencyProblems.pitch: Search engines and assistants have to guess what you are, where you are and when you are open.

agencyProblems.label: Reviews marked up, in a widget or quoted
agencyProblems.question: Do other clients vouch for you?
agencyProblems.fix: Show real client reviews through a review widget, marked up for search engines.
agencyProblems.pitch: Your clients vouch for you elsewhere, and your site never shows it.
